summary: Add guidance (to pmcro-planner's plan contract, e.g. run.plan.asset.md step 2) that a PlanFrame's success_criteria must only assert facts Checker can independently verify as already true by the time check.jsonl is written -- never an outcome owned by a later phase (e.g. Reflector's own Reflection/seal). Cross-reference from pmcro-checker's run.check.asset.md so Checker knows to treat such a criterion as a planning defect (FAIL with that explanation) rather than inventing a 'pending' rationale.
